description: Web platform where employees submit invoice reimbursement requests with supporting docs, finance reviews/approves/rejects/requests-more-info, and both sides can track request status and history.

userStories.title: Database schema and migrations
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the core database tables so that user accounts, requests, documents, and status history can be persisted.
acceptanceCriteria: PostgreSQL schema/migration creates `users` table: id, name, email (unique), password_hash, role ('requester'|'finance', default 'requester'), created_at

Migration creates `requests` table: id, requester_id (FK users), amount, currency, category, expense_date, description, status ('pending'|'approved'|'rejected'|'more_info_needed', default 'pending'), created_at, updated_at
Migration creates `request_documents` table: id, request_id (FK requests), file_name, file_path, file_size, uploaded_at
Migration creates `request_status_history` table: id, request_id (FK requests), status, reason, changed_by_user_id (FK users), changed_at
Migrations run successfully against a local PostgreSQL instance with no errors
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: FastAPI project scaffold and configuration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a runnable FastAPI backend scaffold with environment-based configuration so that subsequent endpoints have a base to build on.
acceptanceCriteria: FastAPI app starts successfully with `uvicorn` and responds to a `/health` endpoint with 200 OK
Database connection string, SMTP settings, upload directory path, and file size/count limits are read from environment variables (.env), not hardcoded
Project structure separates routers, models, and services into distinct modules
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: User signup and login endpoints
userStories.description: As an employee, I want to sign up and log in with email/password so that I have an authenticated identity in the system.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /auth/signup creates a user with hashed password (e.g. bcrypt) and default role 'requester'
POST /auth/signup rejects duplicate emails with a clear 4xx error
POST /auth/login validates credentials and returns a JWT access token on success
POST /auth/login returns a generic error on invalid credentials without revealing whether the email exists
Tests pass
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: Auth dependency and role-based access control
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a reusable auth dependency so that endpoints can require login and restrict finance-only routes.
acceptanceCriteria: A FastAPI dependency validates the JWT from the Authorization header and returns the current user, or 401 if missing/invalid
A second dependency restricts access to users with role 'finance', returning 403 for 'requester' users
Both dependencies are unit tested with valid, missing, and invalid tokens
Tests pass
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: Create reimbursement request endpoint
userStories.description: As a requester, I want an API endpoint to submit a new reimbursement request so that it is stored with status pending.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /requests accepts amount, currency, category, expense_date, description from the authenticated requester
New request is inserted with status 'pending', requester_id set to the logged-in user
Validation rejects missing required fields with a clear 4xx error and message
Response includes the created request's id and status
Tests pass
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: Document upload for requests
userStories.description: As a requester, I want to attach supporting documents to my request so that finance can review them.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /requests/{id}/documents accepts one or more file uploads for a request owned by the current user
Server validates file type (PDF/JPG/PNG only) and rejects others with a clear 4xx error
Server validates file size (max 10MB per file) and file count (max 5 per request), rejecting violations with a clear 4xx error
Accepted files are saved to local disk under `/uploads/{request_id}/{filename}` and metadata is inserted into request_documents
GET /requests/{id}/documents/{doc_id} returns the file for download, restricted to the request's owner or a finance user
Tests pass
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: Email service utility and new-request notification
userStories.description: As a system, I need to send an email to the finance team when a new request is submitted so that they know to review it.
acceptanceCriteria: A reusable email-sending utility is added using SMTP settings from environment variables
When a request is created (US-005), an email is sent to the configured finance distribution address containing requester name, amount, category, and a link/reference to the request
Email sending failure is logged but does not raise an error or block the request creation response
Tests pass (email sending is mocked in tests)
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: Requester's own requests list and detail endpoints
userStories.description: As a requester, I want API endpoints to list my own requests and view full details so that I can track their status.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /requests/mine returns only requests belonging to the logged-in user, sorted by most recently updated first
GET /requests/{id} returns full request details, associated documents, and full status history, restricted to the request's owner or a finance user
Requesting another user's request as a non-owner, non-finance user returns 403
Tests pass
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: Finance pending requests endpoint
userStories.description: As a finance team member, I want an API endpoint listing all pending and more-info-needed requests across all users so that I can review outstanding work.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /requests/pending (finance-only) returns all requests with status 'pending' or 'more_info_needed' across all requesters
Each item includes requester name/email, amount, category, description, expense_date, status, created_at
Non-finance users receive 403
Tests pass
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: Finance all-requests (historic) endpoint with filters
userStories.description: As a finance team member, I want an API endpoint listing all requests regardless of status, filterable by requester/status/category/date, so that I have a full audit trail.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /requests (finance-only) returns all requests regardless of status
Supports query params: requester_id, status, category, date_from, date_to, applying filters server-side
Non-finance users receive 403
Tests pass
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: Finance review action endpoint (approve/reject/request more info)
userStories.description: As a finance team member, I want an endpoint to approve, reject, or request more info on a request with a reason, so that the decision and rationale are recorded.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /requests/{id}/review (finance-only) accepts action ('approve'|'reject'|'more_info') and an optional/required reason field
Reason is required (400 if missing) when action is 'reject' or 'more_info'; optional for 'approve'
Request status is updated accordingly ('approved', 'rejected', or 'more_info_needed')
A row is appended to request_status_history with status, reason, changed_by_user_id, changed_at
Non-finance users receive 403
Tests pass
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: Status-change email notification to requester
userStories.description: As a requester, I want to receive an email when finance changes my request's status so that I know the outcome without checking the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: When a finance review action (US-011) completes, an email is sent to the requester with the new status and the reason/comment provided
Email sending failure is logged but does not block the review action response
Tests pass (email sending is mocked in tests)
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: Resubmission endpoint for more-info-needed requests
userStories.description: As a requester, I want to update and resubmit a request that finance marked as needing more info so that it goes back into the review queue.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /requests/{id}/resubmit (owner-only) allows updating description and/or adding additional documents, only when current status is 'more_info_needed'
On resubmit, status reverts to 'pending' and a status_history entry is appended noting resubmission
Attempting to resubmit a request not in 'more_info_needed' status returns a 4xx error
Tests pass
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: React app scaffold, routing, and auth pages
userStories.description: As an employee, I want to sign up and log in through a web UI so that I can access the platform.
acceptanceCriteria: React app scaffold set up with routing (e.g. react-router) and an auth context storing the logged-in user/JWT
Login page with email/password form, calls POST /auth/login, stores token, redirects to the appropriate home view
Signup page with name/email/password form, calls POST /auth/signup, then redirects to login
Logout clears the stored token and redirects to login
Protected routes redirect unauthenticated users to the login page
Typecheck/lint passes

userStories.title: New Request submission form (UI)
userStories.description: As a requester, I want a form to submit a new reimbursement request with supporting documents so that finance can review it.
acceptanceCriteria: Form includes fields: amount, currency, category (dropdown), expense date, description, and a file upload control (multi-file)
Client-side validation blocks submission when required fields are missing or an invalid file type/size is selected
On submit, calls POST /requests then uploads documents via POST /requests/{id}/documents
On success, shows a confirmation message with the new request's id/status and navigates to 'My Requests'

userStories.title: My Requests list page (UI)
userStories.description: As a requester, I want to see a list of my submitted requests with their status so that I know what's pending, approved, or rejected.
acceptanceCriteria: Page calls GET /requests/mine and lists date submitted, amount, category, truncated description, and a colored status badge (pending=amber, approved=green, rejected=red, more_info_needed=blue)
List is sorted by most recently updated first
Empty state message shown when the user has no requests
Clicking a row navigates to the request detail view

userStories.title: Request detail view (shared component)
userStories.description: As a user, I want a detail view showing full request info, documents, and status history so that I understand the complete context of a request.
acceptanceCriteria: Component calls GET /requests/{id} and displays all fields, a downloadable list of documents, and the full status history (status, reason, changed_by, timestamp) in chronological order
Component is reused by both the requester's 'My Requests' detail and the finance review screens

userStories.title: Resubmit UI for more-info-needed requests
userStories.description: As a requester, I want to edit and resubmit a request that finance flagged as needing more info so that it re-enters the review queue.

Submitting calls POST /requests/{id}/resubmit and, on success, updates the displayed status to 'pending'

userStories.description: As a finance team member, I want to approve, reject, or request more info directly from the request detail view, with a reason, so that the requester is informed of the decision.
